newsitem.title: ITALY: Austrians hope to learn from Stet link.
newsitem.headline: Austrians hope to learn from Stet link.

text.p: Austrian mobile phone operator Mobilkom Austria hopes to learn from its association with Italy's Telecom Italia Mobile and develop the skills needed to expand in Eastern Europe, an Austrian official said.
Erich Becker, chief financial officer of Austrian state holding company OIAG, said that despite the low penetration of mobile phones in Austria, Mobilkom would have to look further afield to expand.
"We hope this will be a very interesting cooperation and we can learn a lot from TIM," Becker told a news conference on Austria's privatisation program.
OIAG has responsibility for Austrian state telecoms monopoly Post und Telekom Austria (PTA), Becker said.
Italy's Stet, which controls TIM, is acquiring a 25 percent stake in Mobilkom.
"We have only seven million inhabitants and penetration is seven percent and it will grow," said Becker.
"We will learn how to manage the network better and how to grow in other East European markets," he said. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
